screens.content: Maya arrives quite early for the music class and collects a form from reception. The main hall is noisy, so she finds a quiet corner near the stairs. The form asks for her name and a contact number. A neighbor waits while she writes, then she takes the page from the clipboard and leaves it with the clerk. Theo later checks that quiet and quite were not swapped on the filed copy. The back office stays quiet while the front desk grows quite busy. She copies the date onto a form from the clerk and never types from where form belongs. Theo confirms that quiet corner was not typed as quite corner.
